rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402 and halting new event recordings while live view remained unaffected. Enabling loop recording immediately restored new clips in the event list, confirming the root cause. The customer's broadband concern was a red herring — uplink status was OK and all devices were online.

repair_steps: Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage.
If customer wants to keep existing clips, export them first, then format storage.
Confirm new events are recording in the event list.
output.customer_reply: We found the base station storage was full and loop recording was off, which stopped new recordings. I've enabled loop recording, so new clips are now saving. If you'd like to keep old clips, export them before formatting. Let us know if you need further help!

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).
